composition.tilted_horizon.contents: focus held at 3-7deg tilt. Horizon slightly tilted. Floor lines diagonal. Casual careless tilt.

composition.poor_headroom.contents: Either excessive empty space above head or head cramped near frame top. Spacing imbalanced. Head placement uncentered relative to frame edges.

composition.uneven_floor_tilt.contents: Floor perspective uneven. Careless frame angle. Hasty handheld framing.

composition.environmental_clutter.contents: Background equipment positioned awkwardly - jutting from subject or distracting tangents. viewer's didn't adjust angle to avoid clutter.

composition.snapshot_mentality.contents: Pure snapshot - single quick exposure without adjustment. First-take accepted regardless of quality. No refinement. Utilitarian record over presentation.

composition.lazy_standing_position.contents: Focus position lazy - framed from wherever viewer was standing. No effort to find better angle. Convenience over composition.

composition.subject_drastically_off_cent.contents: Subject positioned arbitrarily. Zero composition skill. Hasty amateur recording.

composition.awkward_headroom.description: Too much or too little space above head
composition.awkward_headroom.contents: Either massive empty space above head (30-40% of frame) or head cramped near top edge. Imbalanced vertical spacing. Awkward vertical framing.

composition.background_clutter_intersect.contents: Background equipment intersects subject awkwardly. Pole or table edge growing from head location. viewer's made no effort to shift angle for cleaner composition.

composition.subject_partially_cropped.description: Subject awkwardly cut off at edges
composition.subject_partially_cropped.contents: Subject's arm or hand partially cut off by frame edge - viewer's didn't account for full gesture. Edge of dress clipped awkwardly. Careless.
